items.title: Positive minimal volume entropy under fiber non-collapsing and thickness
items.difficulty_reason: The authors connect fiber non-collapsing to a covering condition using thickness, develop quantitative width and ball-volume estimates, and remove combinatorial restrictions through attaching simplices and splitting locally separating vertices. Their final proof applies the quantitative bound to a suitable 2-regular component and uses limiting metric and entropy estimates. The cited prior width and growth results retain their original attribution; this assessment does not independently certify the proof.
